model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of knowledge editing methods on a long-tail biomedical knowledge triples dataset across different groups. The y-axis is labeled "%," and it is a linear scale ranging from 33.35 to 98.60, with tick labels at regular intervals of 10. A blue line, represented by solid circles, shows the performance of the "ROME" group, starting at 33.89 at x=0 and increasing to 98.60 at x=68.42. A green line, represented by solid triangles, shows the performance of the "MEMIT" group, starting at 37.32 at x=0 and increasing to 89.60 at x=68.42. A red line, represented by solid squares, shows the performance of the "FT" group, starting at 32.52 at x=0 and increasing to 96.81 at x=68.42.
